This asks for %1$s to be analyzed next. The vote is a transaction carrying a memo, so the wallet that signs it is the voter, and anyone can count the votes from the chain.
A vote weighted by stake is decided by the largest stake. One wallet staking more than the rest outweighs them all, and nothing here corrects for that.
